task.title: Check Dependencies and Integration Points Affecting Key Resolution
task.shortdesc: Identify build, editor, and map integration dependencies that can prevent key definitions in the root map from being available to other topics.

step.cmd: Confirm your editor/tooling is configured to resolve keys from the map context (project/workspace association, DITA-OT integration, or CMS map context).
Verify that any content management system or build pipeline exports both the root map and all referenced submaps/topics so key definitions are available at authoring time.
Check whether conref/keyref resolution is performed by a preview/build step rather than live in the editor; if so, run the configured preview/build that resolves keys.
Inspect any preprocessing steps (map flattening, chunking, branch filtering) that might remove <keydef> elements before the editor computes Insert keyword suggestions.
Validate that referenced resources used by keydefs (topics, images, external links) are accessible with correct paths/URIs from the root map location.
If using multiple deliverables/profiles, confirm each profile includes the same keydef source map or a shared keys map referenced consistently.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
